verdict.rationale: Anthropic's own docs confirm official Claude apps on both iOS and Android. There is an App Store install guide, the homepage lists iOS and Android chat, and voice mode is documented on Claude Mobile for iOS and Android and 'built to work best from your phone.' Missing for 10: documentation of mobile feature parity (projects, file uploads, connectors, artifacts on mobile), an Android install guide, and independent hands-on corroboration of the mobile experience.

support.subject: As a knowledge-worker, I can use full-featured official mobile apps for iOS and Android

citations.quote: You can install the Claude app onto your iOS device by navigating to the App Store and searching for “Claude by Anthropic”
Chat on web, iOS, Android, and on your desktop
Voice mode is a beta feature available to all plans (Free, Pro, Max, Team, and Enterprise) on Claude Mobile (iOS and Android), Claude Desktop, and the web, but is built to work best from your phone.
